summary: SiteDocument is a data entity representing a document associated with a site in the HSPnet system.
purpose: To provide storage for document information related to a specific site.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site document.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the site to which the document belongs.

content_gaps: No workflow, business rules, actors, or validations described.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides a web interface for staff administrators to view and filter employment applications, with date, site, and discipline filters, error/warning panels, and paging capabilities.
purpose: To help staff administrators filter and review student employment applications submitted through HSPnet, including error/warning tracking and last login display.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Start date for submitted applications filter.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: End date for submitted applications filter.

workflows.name: Review Employment Applications
steps: Select site, discipline, and date range filters.
Refresh view to display filtered employment applications.

business_rules: StartDate must be less than or equal to EndDate.
Date fields require valid date format.
Withdrawn applications can be toggled for inclusion.
validations: Required field validation for StartDate and EndDate.
Custom validation to ensure StartDate <= EndDate.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
Show last login panel if the session variable is not empty.
system_behavior: RefreshData binds data to the gridview after filters are applied.
Error and warning panels can be hidden by user interaction.
exceptions: If UserSession is missing, selection is cancelled.

summary: ServiceCode is a data entity representing service codes used in HSPnet, with alternate-language fields for localization.
purpose: To provide structured information for service codes, including categorization, sorting, and localization support.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short display name for the code.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Additional notes for the service code.

workflows.name: Service Code Listing
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all service codes.
Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID/TimetableID to get service codes for a specific course or timetable.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use NameAlt and NotesAlt instead of Name and Notes.
conditions: Language field selection depends on session UseAltLanguageFields.
system_behavior: ServiceCodes retrieves service codes based on procedure calls and session parameters.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
content_gaps: No actors, no validations, limited business rules.

summary: SiteProfileHistory is a record of changes made to a site profile in HSPnet, capturing who made the change, when, what section, and what data was affected.
purpose: To audit changes to site profiles and provide details about actions, actors, and context for each change.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the history record.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date and time of the action.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if actor is a system admin.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session.
Return a list of SiteProfileHistory records.
Display formatted details including user and agency information.

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is true or ByUserID equals ByOriginalUserID, agency user formatting changes.
Use alternate language fields if UseAltLanguageFields is set on session.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: format depends on admin status and user IDs.
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted: detailed tooltip includes name, agency, and phone if present.
system_behavior: FillSiteDropdown and FillDisciplineDropdown methods to set UI control sources.
Automatically audit and record changes to site profiles.
content_gaps: No error handling, no exceptions described.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is an entity used to manage email attachments/files in popup dialogs, including searching and deleting files.
purpose: To support searching, displaying, and deleting email documents (attachments) for popups in the HSPnet application.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the email document.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Whether the document is selected/checked in UI.

workflows.name: Email Document Search
steps: Parse string and build list of EmailPopupDocument entities.

workflows.name: Delete Email Document
steps: Call EmailPopupDocuments.Delete with data info and ID.
Delete specified file and folder from disk.

business_rules: Email data must be parsed into ID, FileName, FilePath.
Delete operation removes both file and containing folder if possible.
conditions: If file/folder does not exist, deletion is skipped.
system_behavior: Search parses data info strings into objects.
Delete attempts filesystem operation and fails silently on exception.
dependencies: System.IO for file and directory deletion.
exceptions: File/Directory deletion catches and ignores exceptions.
content_gaps: No actors, no validations, limited workflow context.
